description: Returns how many LLCs were formed in New York in the latest full month, the change from a year earlier, the year to date, the top counties, New York City's share and the share filed through commercial registered agents, from the Department of State's register (refreshed daily) as analyzed by Cheap NY Publication. Use for questions about how many LLCs are formed in New York, trends, or counties.
name: get_ny_llc_formation_statistics
title: New York LLC formation statistics
